studies.title: Matte Neutral
studies.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: LCL game art exploration, landscape single scene.
Input images: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, Bowl Watch. Images 2–5 are TECHNOLOGY DESIGN REFERENCES ONLY; use their transferable construction ideas, not exact branded objects or text.
Primary request: Redesign the food machinery in Bowl Watch with these technology influences and render the SAME scene as a restrained matte modeled game background, with NO watercolour, NO paper grain, NO pigment blooms and NO sketch lines. This is the neutral colour control.
Composition invariants: Preserve exact elevated overhead three-quarter oblique/trimetric near-parallel camera, framing, continuous floor, staircase and gallery, concrete piers, bowl shelves and bench, serving bank, overhead supply pipe, repair station. Keep exactly FIVE people at the same positions and scale: four adults holding bowls, fifth servicing the right cassette. Keep all FOUR open serving trays and their bowls, closed utility modules and unobstructed paths. No new narrative events, horizon, cutaway diorama or cinematic perspective.
Technology translation: Replace generic aged medieval-looking mechanical trims with original compact municipal modules: chunky rounded-corner cream enamel housings, inset dark curved-glass diagnostic screen in the right service area, recessed handles, round selectors, small square pushbuttons, asymmetric removable access panels, exposed screw heads, slotted vents and legible restrained stencil pictograms. Use a few worn edges and different-age replacement panels, but surfaces mostly maintained. Service piping remains readable and coupled, not random greeble. Borrow construction from the extinguisher, terminal, illustrated tool and computer assembly, but do NOT add a gun, extinguisher, floating exploded hardware, copied labels or logos.
Medium: High quality tactile matte miniature/prerendered RPG environment. Deliberately simplified clean broad surfaces, controlled ambient occlusion, solid clear silhouettes, diffuse material response, no photographic microtexture, NO wet gloss or shiny PBR. Concrete, ceramic enamel, timber and cloth should remain visibly distinct. Avoid illustrative paper texture entirely.
Lighting/colour: Moody dark neutral slate concrete and graphite shadows, bone/ivory utility casings, muted brown human cloth and timber, only small purposeful amber task lamps and subdued green status indicators. Do NOT flood all materials with sepia/brown. No dominant coloured paint accent; handles and panel trims remain neutral. Keep route and person readability. No candy pastels, generalized neon or magical glow.
Output: One full landscape image, no collage, no captions, no UI, no watermark.
studies.observations: All five figures, four serving trays, camera and major anchors retained. Chunky modular enamel panels, inset screen, knobs, vent grilles and cassette service area added within existing footprint. Screen inherited a globe-like image from the terminal reference. No paper wash apparent; solid matte modeling and subtle mottled concrete remain. Local amber lighting still warms some neutral surfaces. Exact projection is not measured.

studies.title: Opaque Signal
studies.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: LCL medium exploration, opaque painted game scene.
Input image: sole edit target is technology-redesigned Bowl Watch Matte Neutral.
Keep the SAME overhead oblique/trimetric near-parallel camera, framing, grounded playfield, every major architectural anchor, exactly FIVE people at the same positions, four open serving trays and bowls, inset screen, modular hardware, staircase/gallery, left shelf/bench, right service cassette and repairer. No new event or prop. Landscape full scene, no caption, border, UI, horizon or floating diorama.
Primary request: Radically redraw this scene as an OPAQUE GOUACHE / tempera concept painting, preserving dark mood and solid architectural forms. Broad confident flat brush shapes and 3–4 selected value masses, handmade edge decisions, larger clean patches of painted colour. Let enamel, floor and cloth have distinct brush handling. Retain defining bolts, a few knobs, screen and vents, but dramatically suppress repeated minute marks; eliminate precise smooth volumetric gradients and noisy speckling. This must visibly differ from both the modeled render and watercolor texture filter: NO translucent pigment pools, NO wet blooms, NO visible white paper, NO mottled procedural wash overlay, NO pencil/hatch outlines. Use matte opaque dry paint, dark filled forms and selectively broken hand-painted edges. Readability and people’s gestures preserved.
Palette/lighting: neutral charcoal/slate concrete, dark brown cloth/wood, bone cream hardware, small amber practical lights with designed sharp-to-soft pools. Keep deep shadows, not a globally bright washed-out image. Add one repeated oxide-coral painted family to a narrow upper strip across serving modules, pipe collars, and small hem/bands on the FOUR bowl holders’ existing robes. These are non-emissive surface paints/dyes, not glowing red effects or a global sepia grade. A little colour identity, most of the scene stays neutral.
No logos copied from references; no new language, ornament or candy pastel palette.
studies.observations: All five people, four trays and major anchors retained. Broad opaque faceted brush marks and darker filled shapes replace washed-out paper; no white margin. Hardware remains quite precise, so simplification is partial. Coral stripe/collars and trim on all five garments recur with more worn/duller pigment; shoulder bands and right repairer sash extend beyond the four-person trim request. Floor still has abundant brush marks, lighting/contrast and tiny hardware details differ. This is an opaque-paint and modeled-detail hybrid, not fully flat gouache.

authority: Exploratory hypotheses only. User is reconsidering watercolour; previous Paper preference is historical, not final approval.
comparison: 2 × 2: medium (matte modeled vs watercolour) × repeated surface accent (neutral vs oxide-coral). All four share a technology redesign of Bowl Watch. Generation is approximate and cannot ensure pixel-identical lighting or geometry. A fifth opaque gouache/tempera proposal explores another medium, outside that matrix.
colour_hypothesis: A location's stronger colour recurs on purposeful municipal surface paint and adopted garment trim. This is one local test; no per-world palette rule is accepted. Functional amber/green lamps are separate from the non-emissive colour identity.
